atAGlance: Nước dừa is young coconut water, clean and lightly sweet, a simple taste of tropical Vietnam at markets, beaches, and roadside stalls.
whatItIs: Nước dừa is water from a young coconut, sometimes served in the coconut itself. Expect fresh coconut water that is clean, lightly sweet, nutty, and cooling.
howToEnjoy: Drink it cold and scoop the soft coconut flesh if it is offered.
howLocalsOrder: Nước dừa is often ordered as a whole coconut or takeaway cup. Ask for no ice and coconut flesh if you want the clean, lightly sweet coconut experience.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước dừa is one of the simplest ways to taste tropical Vietnam at beaches, markets, and street carts.
goodToKnow: Usually not as sweet as bottled coconut drinks.
